name: Bosutinib Monohydrate

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Gastrointestinal Toxicity: Monitor and manage as necessary. Withhold, dose reduce, or discontinue BOSULIF. ( 2.3 , 5.1 ) • Myelosuppression: Monitor blood counts and manage as necessary. Withhold, dose reduce, or discontinue BOSULIF. ( 2.4 , 5.2 ) • Hepatic Toxicity: Monitor liver enzymes…

summary: Warnings for Bosutinib Monohydrate include digestive tract toxicity, hepatic toxicity, and myelosuppression, which is a condition requiring blood counts to be monitored [3]. The warnings state that patients should have their liver enzymes monitored and that the drug may need to be withheld, reduced in dose, or stopped to manage these issues [3]. Separately, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a high score for liver concerns and a medium score for heart concerns [M].
